017package org.apache.juneau.http;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * Utility for masking the values of header names that commonly carry account credentials
023 * (bearer tokens, session cookies, API keys, and the like) before they are written somewhere
024 * observable, such as a log line or an echoed-back response body.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * Matching is always case-insensitive, mirroring HTTP header-name semantics.
028 *
029 * <p class='bjava'>
030 *    <jc>// Default set: mask only the well-known credential-bearing headers.</jc>
031 *    String <jv>masked</jv> = RedactedHeaders.<jsm>redact</jsm>(<js>"authorization"</js>, <js>"Bearer abc123"</js>);
032 *    <jc>// masked == "[REDACTED]"</jc>
033 *
034 *    String <jv>kept</jv> = RedactedHeaders.<jsm>redact</jsm>(<js>"User-Agent"</js>, <js>"curl/8.0"</js>);
035 *    <jc>// kept == "curl/8.0"</jc>
036 * </p>
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * Callers that need a different or extended header set (for example, an additional
040 * internal-trace header) can pass their own name collection to the two-argument overloads
041 * rather than being limited to {@link #DEFAULT}.
042 *
043 * @since 10.0.0
044 */
045public final class RedactedHeaders {
046
047   /** Sentinel value substituted for a masked header value. */
048   public static final String REDACTED = "[REDACTED]";
049
050   /** Canonical set of header names commonly used to carry credentials, matched case-insensitively. */
051   public static final Set<String> DEFAULT = Set.of(
052      "Authorization", "Cookie", "Set-Cookie", "Proxy-Authorization", "X-API-Key");
053
054   private RedactedHeaders() {}
055
056   /**
057    * Returns {@code true} if the given header name is in {@link #DEFAULT} (case-insensitive).
058    *
059    * @param name The header name to test. Can be {@code null} (returns {@code false}).
060    * @return {@code true} if the name matches one of {@link #DEFAULT}, case-insensitively.
061    */
062   public static boolean isSensitive(String name) {
063      return isSensitive(name, DEFAULT);
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Returns {@code true} if the given header name matches one of {@code names}, case-insensitively.
068    *
069    * @param name The header name to test. Can be {@code null} (returns {@code false}).
070    * @param names The candidate header names. Can be {@code null} or empty (returns {@code false}).
071    *    {@code null} elements are ignored.
072    * @return {@code true} if {@code name} matches one of {@code names}, case-insensitively.
073    */
074   public static boolean isSensitive(String name, Collection<String> names) {
075      if (name == null || names == null)
076         return false;
077      for (var n : names)
078         if (n != null && name.equalsIgnoreCase(n))
079            return true;
080      return false;
081   }
082
083   /**
084    * Masks {@code value} with {@link #REDACTED} if {@code name} is in {@link #DEFAULT}
085    * (case-insensitive); otherwise returns {@code value} unchanged.
086    *
087    * @param name The header name. Can be {@code null} (never matches; {@code value} is returned as-is).
088    * @param value The header value to mask. Can be {@code null}.
089    * @return {@link #REDACTED} if {@code name} is sensitive, else {@code value}.
090    */
091   public static String redact(String name, String value) {
092      return isSensitive(name) ? REDACTED : value;
093   }
094
095   /**
096    * Masks {@code value} with {@link #REDACTED} if {@code name} matches one of {@code names}
097    * (case-insensitive); otherwise returns {@code value} unchanged.
098    *
099    * @param name The header name. Can be {@code null} (never matches; {@code value} is returned as-is).
100    * @param value The header value to mask. Can be {@code null}.
101    * @param names The candidate header names. Can be {@code null} or empty (nothing is masked).
102    * @return {@link #REDACTED} if {@code name} matches one of {@code names}, else {@code value}.
103    */
104   public static String redact(String name, String value, Collection<String> names) {
105      return isSensitive(name, names) ? REDACTED : value;
106   }
107}
